threads.body: README uses single-backtick markup (interpreted text) and has a comma splice/trailing whitespace in the new Limitation text. In reStructuredText, inline literals should be written with double backticks, and the paragraph should be split into proper sentences to avoid rstcheck/rendering issues.
threads.hunk:
@@ -67,11 +67,11 @@ Limitations
 ***********
 
 When using the Google GenAI SDK with automatic function calling enabled,
-the OpenTelemetry instrumentation creates a span only for the top-level
-``generate_content`` call.
+the OpenTelemetry instrumentation creates an `execute_tool` span for each tool call the SDK executes, these spans are nested under 
+the `generate_content` span. 
 
-Internal model or tool calls triggered automatically by the SDK are executed
-within the SDK internals and are not traced as separate spans.
+Only tool calls that the SDK executes are traced, if you disable the automatic function calling and instead
+do the function calling in your application, our instrumentation cannot trace them.

threads.body: The new direct dependency on wrapt is unbounded. Please constrain it to the same compatible range used elsewhere in this repo (e.g., opentelemetry-util-genai pins wrapt to >=1.0.0,<3.0.0) to avoid inadvertently accepting incompatible major versions.

For wrapt wrappers, this repo consistently types the `kwargs` parameter as `dict[str, Any]` (not `Mapping[...]`). This better matches what wrapt actually passes and avoids type-checker complaints when later doing `**kwargs` unpacking.

threads.body: `invocation.stop()` / `invocation.fail(...)` are only called after the async stream is fully drained or an exception is raised. If the caller stops consuming early (breaks out of the loop / closes the async generator), this wrapper won’t finalize the invocation, leaving the span open and potentially leaking in-flight telemetry. Consider wrapping the SDK stream with `opentelemetry.util.genai.stream.AsyncStreamWrapper` (preferred) or adding a `finally` path that finalizes the invocation on generator close/cancellation.
